title: Writing one

fields.label: Goals
fields.question: Did the client state their goal? If so, what is it?

fields.label: Working towards
fields.question: Did we make progress towards their goal? Was it prompted?

fields.label: Cultural outcomes
fields.question: Did we connect the client to family, language, community and country?

fields.label: Anything else
fields.question: What did you see, and hear? Anything another support worker or the service provider needs to know?

checklistDefault: It names what I actually did, not the funding category
It says what they did, in words a camera could have recorded
There's nothing in it I concluded rather than saw
Someone covering them next week could use this

rounds.label: Round one
rounds.brief:
Rachael, 24. Transport, 8:30–9:15.

You drove Rachael to the garden centre for her 9:00 start.

The radio was on and she didn't say much.

On the way she mentioned she's been asked to do a Saturday shift next month, and she's going to say yes.
checklist: I picked the thing the next person actually needs
I said what happened, not what I thought about it
Someone who has never met Rachael could use this

modelFields.goals: She didn't say. Nothing this shift told me what she's working towards.
modelFields.working: Drove Rachael to work for her 9:00 start.
modelFields.other: She told me she's been offered a Saturday shift next month and she's going to take it. Whoever arranges her transport will need to know.

rounds.modelNotes: The radio and the quiet drive aren't in it.

rounds.label: Round two
rounds.brief:
Mary, 61. Community access, 10:00–11:45.

You picked Mary up at ten. She had her logbook out of the drawer and in her bag before you got there.

You did thirty minutes of supervised driving practice on the back roads near Avoca. She reverse parked twice without prompting. She wrote it up in the logbook herself while you were parked.

On the way home she talked about her sister coming up from Hervey Bay at the weekend.

You dropped her home at 11:45.
checklist: It names what I actually did, not the funding category
It says what Mary did, in words a camera could have recorded
There's nothing in it I concluded rather than saw
Someone covering Mary next Tuesday could use this

modelFields.goals: Not stated today. Her plan goal is her driver's licence.
modelFields.working: 30 minutes of supervised driving practice on the back roads near Avoca. Mary reverse parked twice, unprompted. She filled in the logbook herself while we were parked.
modelFields.other: She had her logbook in her bag before I arrived.

rounds.modelNotes: The conversation about her sister isn't in it. It was pleasant, but it isn't a support, a response to a support, or a goal.

rounds.label: Round three
rounds.brief:
David, 27. Community access and travel training, 2:00–3:45.

You arrived at two. David was at the door with his bag on. The neighbour's dog was going the whole time you were there.

You caught the 2:15 bus into town. It was late and it was raining. David watched for the stop and pressed the bell himself without you saying anything — first time he's done that.

At the newsagent he said hello to the woman behind the counter in language, then told you what the word meant and that his aunty taught him.

He didn't want to go into the chemist. He waited outside with you and you went in after, once it had emptied out.

You had another client at four, across town. Home by 3:45.
checklist: It names what I actually did, not the funding category
It says what David did, in words a camera could have recorded
There's nothing in it I concluded rather than saw
Someone covering David next Thursday could use this

modelFields.goals: Not stated today. His plan goals are travelling independently around town, and connecting with community and language.
modelFields.working: Caught the 2:15 bus into town. David watched for the stop and pressed the bell himself, unprompted. First time he's done that.
modelFields.cultural: David greeted the woman at the newsagent in language, then explained what the word meant and said his aunty taught him.
modelFields.other: He didn't want to go into the chemist. He waited outside with me and we went in after it had emptied out.

rounds.modelNotes:
The dog, the rain, the late bus and your four o'clock aren't in it.

That last line isn't a goal and it isn't a cultural outcome. It's the thing that makes next week easier for whoever has him.

close.heading: What you did
close.body:
Three notes, spoken out loud, the last one in three minutes. You checked your own before you saw anyone else's.
